verdict.rationale: Elicit's core product generates AI insights from the user's own papers. Chat compares, summarizes and clusters papers; the Research Agent produces reports, tables, figures and slides; AI-extracted columns pull data from imported Zotero, RIS and BIB libraries; and systematic reviews surface screening recommendations. A hands-on user confirmed getting a cited concept list in about a minute, but several other hands-on reports describe hallucinated or incorrect summaries, and Elicit itself advises users to expect roughly 90% accuracy. Missing for 10: reliable independent evidence that the insights are accurate (hands-on reports cite hallucinations and contradictory quotes), and proactive suggestions beyond screening recommendations are only thinly documented.
